translations.web: You have removed my soul far away from peace. I forgot prosperity.
translations.bsb: My soul has been deprived of peace; I have forgotten what prosperity is.
translations.kjv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace: I forgat prosperity.
translations.asv: And thou hast removed my soul far off from peace; I forgat prosperity.
